entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I need to return a jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-21. The name on the order is David Chen.

Thank you, David. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the Pro-Weave Jersey you ordered. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference issue. It's simply the wrong size for me. I tried it on once and it's just way too tight across the shoulders to be comfortable on a ride.

I understand completely, getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just confirm the delivery date here... Okay, I see it was delivered 75 days ago. You're in luck! Our policy for standard apparel like this jersey is 90 days for a return.
Oh, perfect. So I can send it back for a full refund?

Absolutely. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a pre-paid shipping label. Just print it out, attach it to the package with the jersey inside, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued.

That's great, thank you. I do want to get the correct size, though. Since I'm going to place a new order and I had to call in for this exchange, is there any chance you could provide a small discount code for the replacement purchase?

I understand you're looking for an exchange, and I appreciate you asking. While I'm not authorized to generate a discount code for a size-related exchange, I can confirm the return shipping for the jersey that was too tight is completely free with the label I sent you. And any new order over $50 also qualifies for free standard shipping.
Okay, so free shipping both ways. That's fair enough. I appreciate you checking for me. I'll look out for that email.
You're very welcome, David. The email should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
